messages:
Priya: Hey team — quick question. PR #9423 touches /infra/k8s/ingress.yaml and /runtime/kv_cache/config.yaml. CODEOWNERS has different owners for those paths; who can actually approve/merge here? We need the latency fix out before Monday.
Sam: Looks like CODEOWNERS lists @eng-platform for /infra/k8s/ and @eng-runtime for /runtime/**. Do we require both explicit approvals or do we have a proxy rule? :thinking:
Luca: The runtime change is just a default TTL tweak (60 -> 30). Small risk but touches runtime. Can eng-platform cut the merge if runtime owners are offline? cc @Devin
Devin: We usually ask for both owners, but for trivial config-only changes a proxy from one owner team is acceptable if the other owner explicitly says "ok to proxy" in the thread. Share the CODEOWNERS snippet.
Priya: ```
# CODEOWNERS
/infra/k8s/ @eng-platform
/runtime/** @eng-runtime
/scripts/ @devex-team
```
Priya: Files changed: /infra/k8s/ingress.yaml (minor namespace change) and /runtime/kv_cache/config.yaml (TTL default). No code logic changes.
Maya: Policy note: for low-risk config/docs toggles we accept single-team proxy approval when the non-present owner posts an explicit consent comment. For anything touching model-serving logic or serialization code we require explicit owner approval. This is in the ownership playbook. :white_check_mark:
Sam: I couldn't find that playbook link — can someone drop it here?
Maya: Internal link: https://go/internal/ownership-playbook — TL;DR: proxy allowed for trivial, not allowed for behavioral changes.
Luca: @Devin please confirm this is trivial so we can proceed. If yes, leave an "ok to proxy" comment and eng-platform will approve and merge once CI is green.
Devin: Reviewed locally. No behavioral impact. OK to proxy from my side. :+1:
release-bot: CI status: integration-suite failed (flaky test: TestKVCacheEviction). Merge blocked until CI passes or owner override.
Priya: Can someone re-run integration-suite? I can try now.
Sam: Re-running CI now.
Sam: CI passed on rerun. 
Devin: Leaving explicit comment for automation: "Devin: ok for eng-platform proxy-approve for this PR" so we have an audit trail.
Priya: Devin: ok for eng-platform proxy-approve for this PR
Sam: Approved and merged after CI green. :shipit: :tada:
Priya: Thanks everyone — noted for postmortem: add a short clause in CODEOWNERS FAQ about proxy wording to make automation pick up approvals more reliably.
Maya: Good idea. I'll add a short note and an example comment format that bots can parse.
